messages.subject: For Linda Schucroft | Executive Candidate | Strategy, Government Relations & ESG
messages.body:
Dear Oman Airports Executive and Strategy Team,

Please forward this note and attached executive CV to Ms. Linda Schucroft, Chief Strategy, Digital & Experience Officer. I am reaching out because Oman Airports' strategy, infrastructure, digital transformation and national-development mandate aligns closely with the operating environments where I have built my career.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ years of experience span multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, with current responsibility across ESG, government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, social performance, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

I bring direct experience coordinating ministries, regulators, contractors, communities and senior management around major operating and investment priorities. My recent work also includes governance support around large-scale solar and battery-storage deployment, carbon-data readiness, regulatory coordination and strategic stakeholder engagement.

I am targeting leadership mandates across strategy, government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and country or regional growth in Oman and the wider GCC. I am open to expatriate and regional assignments and have a 30-day notice period.

Please find my focused executive CV attached. I would welcome consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates and a confidential discussion with Ms. Schucroft or the appropriate executive leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
